title: Ext comparison agrees with derived map
statement: Let C and D be abelian categories with enough injectives, chosen derived categories, and Ext groups in their common Hom universe. Let V:C→D be additive and preserve finite limits and finite colimits. Let L,Y be objects of C, B an object of D, a:B→V(L), and q a natural number. For morphisms x,y:L[0]→Y[0][q] in D⁺(C), if applying D⁺(V) and precomposing with a[0] followed by the inverse single comparison gives equal images, then exact-functor transport on Ext followed by precomposition with a gives equal images of the Ext classes corresponding to x and y under the bounded-below inclusion and Ext.homEquiv.

proof.text: Apply the bounded-below inclusion to hxy. Expand sourceExtMap and use Ext.comp_hom, Ext.mk₀_hom, Ext.mapExactFunctor_hom, and Ext.homEquiv to express both Ext images as derived morphisms. The included inverse single comparison is the inverse comparison in the full derived category, by cancellation against its hom and ι_map_mapDerivedCategoryPlusSingleFunctor_hom_app. The included mapDerivedCategoryPlus morphism is definitionally the full derived functor applied to the included morphism. Postcompose the included equality with the image of the source inclusion's shift comparison, the derived functor's shift comparison, and the shifted target single comparison. Associativity and map_comp identify this with equality of the Ext representatives; Ext.homEquiv is injective. The argument covers q = 0 and zero objects and needs neither Hom-bijectivity nor acyclicity.

lean.statement:
theorem derivedSourceComparison_ext_compatibility
    {C : Type u₁} {D : Type u₂} [Category.{v} C] [Category.{v} D]
    [Abelian C] [Abelian D] [EnoughInjectives C] [EnoughInjectives D]
    [HasDerivedCategory C] [HasDerivedCategory D]
    [HasExt.{v} C] [HasExt.{v} D]
    (V : C ⥤ D) [V.Additive] [PreservesFiniteLimits V] [PreservesFiniteColimits V]
    (L : C) (B : D) (a : B ⟶ V.obj L) (Y : C) (q : ℕ)
    (x y : (DerivedCategory.Plus.singleFunctor C 0).obj L ⟶
      ((DerivedCategory.Plus.singleFunctor C 0).obj Y)⟦(q : ℤ)⟧)
    (hxy : ((DerivedCategory.Plus.singleFunctor D 0).map a ≫
        (V.mapDerivedCategoryPlusSingleFunctor 0).inv.app L) ≫
        V.mapDerivedCategoryPlus.map x =
      ((DerivedCategory.Plus.singleFunctor D 0).map a ≫
        (V.mapDerivedCategoryPlusSingleFunctor 0).inv.app L) ≫
        V.mapDerivedCategoryPlus.map y) :
    sourceExtMap V L B a Y q
      (Abelian.Ext.homEquiv.symm (ShiftedHom.map x (DerivedCategory.Plus.ι (C := C)))) =
    sourceExtMap V L B a Y q
      (Abelian.Ext.homEquiv.symm (ShiftedHom.map y (DerivedCategory.Plus.ι (C := C))))
